chunks: About a man who prays in intense heat and fears for his forehead from the ground, he said: “He should place his garment beneath his forehead.”

key_terms.جَبْهَتِهِ: his forehead, the place used in sajdah

ai.seo_question: What should a person do in prayer if the ground is too hot for sajdah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one praying on extremely hot ground. If a person fears harm to his forehead during sajdah, he may place his garment beneath his forehead as protection.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
about a man praying in extreme heat and fearing for his forehead due to the hot ground.
Imam (as) replied: "He should place his garment beneath his forehead”.
